info.name: GPU Sound 3: Flight of the Bumblebee (Complete Piano Score)
info.description: Complete 104-measure transcription of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's 'Flight of the Bumblebee' arranged for Piano by Sergei Rachmaninoff (熊蜂の飛行), with shared musical score functions factored into a Common pass.

renderpass.name: Common
renderpass.description: Shared musical score patterns, pitch mapping, and score constants for Flight of the Bumblebee.

renderpass.name: Image
renderpass.description: Concert Grand Piano visual stage with animated keys, vibrating brass strings, and Russian Imperial hall lighting.

renderpass.name: Sound
renderpass.description: Physical-modeling concert grand piano synthesis of the complete 104-measure score of Rimsky-Korsakov's Flight of the Bumblebee (arr. Rachmaninoff).
